ayahs.1: By the sky with its towering constellations,
ayahs.2: by the promised Day of Judgment,
ayahs.3: by the witness and what is witnessed—
ayahs.4: ruined are the makers of the trench,
ayahs.5: the fire pit filled with fuel,
ayahs.7: watching what they did to the believers.
ayahs.8: They resented the believers for no reason except trust in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy,
ayahs.9: to Whom belongs the kingdom of heavens and earth. Allah is Witness over all things.
ayahs.10: Those who persecute believing men and women and do not repent will suffer Hell's punishment and burning torment.
ayahs.11: Those with iman who do righteous deeds will have Gardens with rivers flowing beneath—the greatest triumph.
ayahs.12: The grip of your Rabb is severe.
ayahs.13: He originates creation and repeats it.
ayahs.15: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious,
ayahs.17: Has the story of the destroyed armies reached you—
ayahs.18: Pharaoh and the people of Thamud?
ayahs.19: Yet those who reject the truth persist in denial,
ayahs.20: while Allah encompasses them from every side.
